collection.description: A villager feels left out when a close friend spends time with someone new.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (villager) feels left out when (friend) spends time with someone new.

choices.label: Speak Openly About Feeling Left Out
Invite Both Friends to a Shared Activity
Take Time Before Discussing the Hurt

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (friend) reassures (villager) without abandoning the new friendship.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The conversation reveals that both had felt distant lately.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The three enjoy an unexpectedly funny afternoon.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The gathering feels awkward, and they decide not to force it.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (villager) discovers another friendship can be rewarding.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (friend) misses their usual time together and reaches out.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (villager) returns ready for a calmer conversation.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The silence causes confusion until someone asks what happened.
